intro: Protect Kaya is a Horde escort quest in the Stonetalon Mountains. After discovering Kaya Flathoof held captive by hostile Grimtotem tauren, adventurers guide her through dangerous mountain trails to reach Camp Aparaje. Returning word of her survival brings immense relief to her anxious father, Makaba Flathoof.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thank you for rescuing me! We must leave quickly before they discover that I am free. Please escort me to Camp Aparaje. From there, I know my way.
My father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to know that I am safe.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Kaya is alive! Friend, I have you to thank for rescuing her.
